backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining core types (UserProfile, TestAttempt, Question, TestConfig, etc.) and implementing authorization, blob storage, and data management for users, questions, tests, sessions, and suggestions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three UI improvements to QuestionEditorDialog: solid white background, optional question text field, and proper spacing for all four option inputs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration, detailing styling, routing, data integration, and UI functionality across the application.
frontend/docs/navbar-file-list.md: Documentation listing the Header component file, its usage across pages (Landing, Dashboard, Admin, About), and its features including responsive navigation, authentication controls, and role-based menu items.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO meta tags for MHT-CET mock tests and MathJax CDN configuration for LaTeX math rendering with inline and display delimiters.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component managing routing between views (landing, dashboard, about, admin), authentication state, profile setup modal, view persistence/restoration, and error boundary integration.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that catches application errors and displays a fallback UI with options to navigate home or reload the page.
frontend/src/components/AverageResultPDF: Placeholder component for exporting average test results to PDF, currently disabled and awaiting implementation.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays and manages comments for a question, including posting new comments, deleting comments (with admin privileges), and showing comment metadata with user profiles and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the application footer with copyright information, attribution to caffeine.ai, and disclaimers about COEP affiliation and mentorship.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Main navigation header with responsive design, authentication controls (login/logout), and navigation between views (landing, about, dashboard, admin) with mobile sheet menu support.
frontend/src/components/LeaderboardSecti: Displays overall leaderboard rankings with trophy badges for top 3 positions, highlights current user's position, and includes share functionality.
frontend/src/components/MathContent.tsx: Renders mathematical content using MathJax with support for inline or block display, theme-aware re-rendering, and safe HTML injection.
frontend/src/components/PerTestResultPDF: Placeholder component for exporting per-test detailed results to PDF format (currently disabled and not implemented).
frontend/src/components/PerTestScoreOnly: Placeholder component for exporting per-test score summaries to PDF format (currently disabled and not implemented).
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog for first-time user profile creation, collecting full name, email, and mobile number with form validation and submission handling.
frontend/src/components/QuestionDetailsD: Placeholder dialog component for displaying detailed question information (currently shows only question ID and placeholder text).
frontend/src/components/QuestionEditorDi: Dialog component for creating and editing questions with form fields for subject, chapter, difficulty, question text, options (with image support), correct answer, explanation, and class level. Handles image uploads via ExternalBlob and integrates with create/update question mutations.
Displays a filterable gallery of questions with search, chapter, and difficulty filters. Supports multi-selection of questions and admin-only delete functionality with confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/components/QuestionManageme: Main panel for managing questions by subject with subject selector, question gallery, and admin controls for creating/editing questions. Integrates QuestionGallery and QuestionEditorDialog components.
frontend/src/components/ResultListPDFExp: Placeholder component for exporting result lists to PDF format. Currently disabled with console logging only; full implementation pending.
frontend/src/components/ScheduleTestDial: Dialog for scheduling tests with start and end date/time pickers. Validates time ranges and converts datetime inputs to nanosecond timestamps for backend submission.
frontend/src/components/ShareButtons.tsx: Card component with WhatsApp and Telegram share buttons that open share dialogs with pre-formatted text promoting the MHT-CET preparation platform.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionModera: Admin panel for viewing and moderating user suggestions/feedback with delete functionality and confirmation dialog. Displays suggestions in a scrollable list with timestamps.
frontend/src/components/SuggestionSectio: A card component that allows users to submit feedback/suggestions with a 250-character limit, displaying character count and handling submission via a mutation hook with toast notifications.
frontend/src/components/TestConfigList.t: Displays a grid of test configuration cards showing test details (subject, type, duration, schedule) with status badges and a button to start tests based on their status (scheduled/live/ended/finished).
frontend/src/components/UserManagement.t: A placeholder component for future user management functionality, currently displaying a "coming soon" message in a card layout.
frontend/src/components/ViewActivationOv: Renders a full-screen loading overlay with spinner when a view activation is in progress, conditionally shown based on activation state and target view matching.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeSubscript: A gate component requiring YouTube channel subscription to access tests, with a subscribe button linking to the channel and a verification flow that calls a mutation to mark the user as verified.
frontend/src/contexts/ViewActivationCont: Provides context for managing view activation state during navigation between dashboard and admin views, with automatic safety timeout (5s) and dev logging for debugging activation lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control with admin token and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBootstrappedCaller: Manages user role state by bootstrapping from localStorage and syncing with backend role data, converting between string and enum types and determining admin status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and context provider for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity storage, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for backend API calls with type conversion helpers between frontend and backend data models (UserProfile, TestConfig, Question, Comment, etc.), including mutations for CRUD operations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors using OKLCH color space, plus component-level styles for headers, overlays, and Radix UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page component displaying Concept Delta's mission, story, and authenticity information with cards for different sections and view activation lifecycle management.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPanel.tsx: Admin panel page with role-based access control, displaying SuggestionModerationPanel and QuestionManagementPanel components only for users with admin role.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page showing user profile, test configurations with status, loading/error states, and lazy-loaded SuggestionSection with retry functionality and view activation handling.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page component featuring hero section with branding, YouTube subscription CTA, feature cards, and authentication flow that redirects authenticated users to dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/ResultPage.tsx: Placeholder page component for displaying test results with basic card layout; full implementation pending.
frontend/src/pages/TestInterface.tsx: Placeholder page component for the test-taking interface; full implementation with questions, timer, and submission pending.
frontend/src/types/local.ts: TypeScript type definitions mirroring backend Motoko types including UserProfile, TestAttempt, Question, TestConfig, and leaderboard entries for frontend use.
frontend/src/utils/externalBlob.ts: Utility functions for converting browser File objects to ExternalBlob format, generating display URLs, and validating image files with size/type constraints.
frontend/src/utils/questionPdfExport.ts: Placeholder module for PDF export functionality with planned support for exporting questions with MathJax rendering, answers, and explanations; not yet implemented.
frontend/src/utils/roleBootstrap.ts: Per-principal role persistence utility using localStorage to cache admin/user roles for flicker-free UI rendering on page load.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities supporting both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions for sensitive parameters.
frontend/src/utils/viewPersistence.ts: Session storage utilities for persisting and restoring app view state with validation against an allowlist of valid views.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme (including status colors), container settings, animations, and plugins for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for a physics mock test platform showing 3 in-progress UI fixes for the Create Question dialog (background transparency, optional question text, option field visibility). Contains 9 pending feature requests to restore missing functionality including user management, test creation/management, leaderboard, and analytics features after a partial rebuild left only 3 of 25+ backend methods implemented.
